rows.prompt: My config import fails when the path is ../../config/settings.json but works with a full path. Why would a relative path behave differently?

probe.prompt: My config import fails when the path is ../../config/settings.json but works with a full path. Why would a relative path behave differently?
probe.output: The difference in behavior between a relative path (../../config/settings.json) and an absolute path (/full/path/to/config/settings.json) is due to how the operating system interprets the path. A relative path is resolved relative to the current working directory, while an absolute path is resolved from the root of the file system. If the current working directory is not what you expect, it could cause the relative path to fail. To diagnose this, you can use the `pwd` command in Unix/Linux or the `cd` command in Windows to check and change the current working directory.
